question.text:
The monomer (X) involved in the synthesis of Nylon 6,6 gives positive carbylamine test. If 10 moles of $\mathbf{X}$ are analyzed using Dumas method, the amount (in grams) of nitrogen gas evolved is ______ .
Use: Atomic mass of N (in amu) = 14

solution.text: Hexamethylene diamine series give $(+)$ carbylamine test. $\mathrm{C}_{\mathrm{x}} \mathrm{H}_{\mathrm{y}} \mathrm{N}_{\mathrm{z}}+(2 \mathrm{x}+1 / 2) \mathrm{CuO} \rightarrow \mathrm{xCO}_2+\frac{\mathrm{y}}{2} \mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}+\frac{\mathrm{z}}{2} \mathrm{~N}_2$ (Dumas method) $\mathrm{C}_6 \mathrm{H}_{16} \mathrm{~N}_2$ then $\frac{\mathrm{z}}{2} \mathrm{~N}_2=\frac{2}{2} \mathrm{~N}_2=1$ mole Given 10 mole in this reaction so $\mathrm{w}_{\mathrm{N}_2}=10 \times 28=280 \mathrm{gm}$
